explanation: The theorem says every fibre of the library's own map `puncturedDiscPow` (z ↦ z^e on the punctured unit disc) has exactly e points. I found no Mathlib statement about fibres of this map. Its content comes from the library's definition together with the facts that a nonzero complex number has exactly e e-th roots and that `Polynomial.nthRootsFinset` is the set of those roots. I grepped Mathlib for `card_nthRoots`, `card_nthRootsFinset` and `card_pow_eq`. The only matches are `IsPrimitiveRoot.card_nthRoots` and `card_nthRootsFinset` (the case a = 1), and general bounds. None of them states the fibre-cardinality result. The proof uses `hζ.card_nthRootsFinset_of_pow_eq`, which I did not find in Mathlib; it is probably local to the library. Even if it is in Mathlib, it is only an ingredient, since the rest of the proof shows the fibre maps bijectively onto the root set.
